items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And then Jean Carroll sang 'Just A Closer Walk With Thee,' beautiful.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And I was very close to him, I mean, I was like his son. And we gave him this New Orleans funeral, see, and we played him in and then we played him out.
And then Jean Carroll sang 'Just A Closer Walk With Thee,' beautiful. And then we did some tunes in the Catholic Church, with the mass. It was beautiful.
Now, if that happened in New Orleans, the Chicago Tribune would have run pictures of it.
